**Write in whatever language you are comfortable in.** The tracker is kept in English so that anyone reading it can follow a thread they had no part in, and we will translate yours if it arrives in Spanish or Catalan. A request in your own language is worth far more to us than one you decided not to file. We answer in the language you wrote in.

**What are you trying to do?**
The task from your organisation's side: "collect a donation from someone who is not a member", "charge a different price to each membership type". What you need, rather than how you think it should work.

**How do you handle it today?**
The workaround, the spreadsheet, the thing somebody does by hand every month. This is usually the most useful part of a request, because it says what a feature would actually have to replace.

**What would it look like for you?**
If you have a shape in mind, describe it. If you do not, skip it. We would rather design against your problem than against a guess at your solution.

**Anything else**
Whether this blocks you, and when it starts to matter. We will not promise you a date, but we will tell you where it sits.
